name: phase5-strategy-calibration
note: This file is the experiment specification. It was written BEFORE any measurement and is READ by the calibration code: the code never hardcodes a range. Calibration may move ONLY signal-detection thresholds. Risk geometry (baseLev/stopPct/targetPct) and strategy semantics are FROZEN and never searched.
hardRules: no randomness: finite grids, deterministic ordering, identical input -> identical output
no look-ahead: a decision bar may only see data timestamped <= that bar
control is always inside the searched space (a strategy may always keep CONTROL)
every tested configuration is persisted, including failures (no silent discards)
the TEST fold is evaluated once, after the configuration is frozen
calibration datasets never touch live state, live shadow files or the live learner

hour.role: primary calibration + counterfactual resolution for the four daily-signal strategies

quarter.role: intraday strategies (ibreakout, orb) + all-strategy co-firing / cohort panel

causality.dailyContext: daily bars whose UTC date is STRICTLY EARLIER than the decision bar date, plus the decision bar's own price as the (partial) current daily value -- exactly what the live engine has at decision time. The decision day's FINAL daily close is never visible.
causality.intradayContext: intraday closes up to and including the decision bar (the decision bar is complete)
causality.resolution: a candidate is resolved ONLY on bars strictly AFTER its decision bar
causality.note: tests/phase5.test.mjs mutates future bars and asserts decisions do not change

resolutionModel.note: OFFLINE counterfactual (shadow-like) resolution reusing perp.mjs cost model. Documented differences from the live shadow layer: (1) bars, not 30s quotes; intra-bar extremes are used with a CONSERVATIVE ordering -- liquidation, then stop before target when both levels are touched in the same bar; (2) no funding accrual (historical funding rates are not available offline => omitted, bias is small and documented); (3) no wallet/cap/council gates (counterfactual dataset).
resolutionModel.stopFill: at the stop level, never worse: a long that gaps below its stop fills at min(stopLevel, barOpen)
resolutionModel.targetFill: at the target level, never better
resolutionModel.timeTrailFill: at the EMA mark (same policy as live/shadow)
resolutionModel.maeMfe: computed from intra-bar extremes against isolated margin

objective.note: Signal-ecosystem quality, NOT maximum historical return. P&L is one bounded component; a configuration is never selected for candidate volume alone, and thin samples are neutral (never rewarded).

componentForms.note: Exact functional forms of the composite. Documented BEFORE any measurement; never adjusted after seeing results.
componentForms.availability: rate = signals/evaluations; availability = min(1, rate/targetCandidateRate); if rate > maxCandidateRate then availability *= maxCandidateRate/rate (turnover/cost penalty)
componentForms.diversity: 0.5*(symbolsCovered/symbolsAvailable) + 0.25*sideCoverage + 0.25*trendContextCoverage(proxy), sideCoverage = 1 if both sides fired, 0.5 if one side (a structurally long-only strategy is NOT punished for having no shorts), 0 if none
componentForms.quality: if resolved sample >= minResolvedForQuality: clamp(0.5 + meanR/qualityWindowR, 0, 1) else qualityNeutral (thin samples are neutral: never rewarded, never punished)
componentForms.stability: fraction of stabilityFolds chronological sub-folds of the TRAIN fold with >=1 candidate
componentForms.tieBreak: highest score wins; equal scores are broken by lexicographic grid key (deterministic)

validationGate.note: a calibrated parameter set replaces CONTROL for a strategy ONLY if it is not worse than CONTROL on the validation fold (candidate availability, cost-adjusted quality within tolerance, composite score). Otherwise the strategy keeps CONTROL and the reason is recorded.

semantics.tsmom: time-series momentum / trend following (strictly: 28d return threshold + 200-SMA agreement)
semantics.donchian: breakout of a prior N-day channel, trend-filtered
semantics.rsi2dip: short-term mean reversion (2-period RSI extreme) inside a trend filter
semantics.mom_trend: momentum + trend confirmation, long only (source specifies no short entry)
semantics.orb: opening-range breakout (US session, first 30m range, live-only strategy)
semantics.ibreakout: intraday breakout of the prior 48x15m range

frozenBySemantics: a strategy's KIND never changes: trend stays trend, breakout stays breakout, mean-reversion stays mean-reversion
side rules never change: mom_trend remains long-only (no synthetic shorts)
risk geometry never changes: stopPct/targetPct/baseLev are not searched
orb remains US-session based; ibreakout remains crypto 15m based
